title: VERY Short Pumping Life
text: VERY Short Pumping Life. I originally really liked this two bottle pump set when I bought them in May of 2020, and even bought a 2nd set in July of 2020.  Initially, all 4 pumped well with nice thick foam.  BUT by December of 2020 three of the four bottles would pump only a thin watery output with very large bubbles rather than foam.  To have a "refillable" pump fail in such a short time drops my recommendation to only a single star.  The pump should either be redesigned or manufactured with different materials to insure a reasonable life of pumping.  With the current pump, I WOULD NOT recommend any one purchase this two bottle pump set.
